proposals.evidence: CDIAL 8201 subsection 2 *piphīla explicitly gives Lahnda pehlā/pehlī and Awankari pèlā/pèlī ant. Awankari/Pothwari pel/pil forms match this regional family; vowel and aspiration variation are retained and qualified. This follows the western comparison rather than assigning short pil forms everywhere to *pilīla. Exact local transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: peli.
